messages:
incident-bot: PAGE triggered for customer OpalBank (dedicated pool, eu-west-1) — p99 latency crossed SLO for the last 5m. metric: p99=3.2s (SLO=1.5s). error-rate stable. alert link: https://console.redwood.ai/alerts/INC-1745004321 :rotating_light:
oncall-sre: ACK — I’m on it. Starting triage now. Joining war room.
oncall-sre: Quick check: any recent deploys to the dedicated pool?
sam-se: No deploys in the last hour from model infra. Noted an increase in average sequence length for OpalBank traffic around 15:12 UTC. Could be longer contexts.
maria-cs: OpalBank CS (cs-rep-opalbank) is on the line — they report timeouts in checkout flows for about 2% of requests and a few delayed payments. Customer impact = payment latency + some retries. They’re asking for a mitigation asap.
liz-pm: Prioritize mitigations that don’t lose data. Can we do a temporary traffic cap and failover some traffic to warm spare region? Also notify the customer with ETA.
kevin-eng: Triage notes from runtime: p99 spikes show long tail at token generation stage, kv-cache miss rate jumped to 38% for this tenant. Likely KV pressure from context sizes + concurrency.
kevin-eng: Possible mitigations: 1) increase dedicated pool nodes 2) enable tenant-level request throttling (soft cap) 3) route a % of OpalBank traffic to eu-central warm spare with fallback 4) switch to lower-memory quantized model variant (q4_0) for that tenant for short term.
oncall-sre: Let's do 1) and 2) in parallel. Scaling first to reduce queueing, then throttle if node add takes >2m.
kevin-eng: Running scale command now (Redwood CLI):
```bash
redwood infra scale --pool opalbank-eu-west --add 4 --type=gpu-a100
```
ops-bot: Job queued: scale-job-85231. Estimated start 30s. Watch cluster events: https://console.redwood.ai/clusters/opalbank-eu-west/events
oncall-sre: I’m patching an ephemeral tenant cap policy: 200 rps -> 120 rps for tenant opalbank. This is a soft throttle (429 backoff header set).
kevin-eng: Pushing throttle rule:
```json
{ "tenant": "opalbank", "rps": 120, "mode": "soft" }
```
ops-bot: Throttle applied (rule-id: throttle-1745004321). Metrics should reflect within 30s.
cs-rep-opalbank: Thanks, we see a drop in timeouts for some users, but still intermittent failures on heavy checkout flows.
sam-se: Observed KV miss rate dropping to 18% after throttle. Request latency p95 improved, p99 still ~2.6s. Scaling job still provisioning svc nodes.
oncall-sre: If p99 > 2s after node add, we will do % traffic reroute. Who can own the reroute?
kevin-eng: I can flip routing. Suggest 20% -> eu-central warm spare for steady-state. We'll ensure model variant compatibility.
maria-cs: I’ve drafted a short status to OpalBank: "We are actively mitigating — applying throttles and scaling your dedicated pool. Expect initial improvements within 2–3 minutes; we will follow with cross-region reroute if needed. Escalation to engineering is ongoing." Shall I send?
liz-pm: Send now. Add note: we’ll follow up with postmortem and any config changes.
maria-cs: Sent to OpalBank CSM and comms channel. Customer replied: "Thank you — please keep us posted. We have payments team on standby"
ops-bot: Scale job update: scale-job-85231 -> nodes_ready (4 nodes added). Pool capacity +4 GPUs.
sam-se: After nodes online: p99 dropped to 1.3s for 1m, then climbed to 1.8s during a burst. Looks like KV-cache warmup is needed for long contexts.
kevin-eng: I'll push a short-term model variant switch for new requests from that tenant to q4_0_small (lower latency) for 10m window. Command:
```bash
redwood routing set-tenant-model --tenant opalbank --model q4_0_small --duration 10m --priority emergency-1745004321
```
ops-bot: Routing change queued (route-job-76200).
cs-rep-opalbank: We see a measurable latency improvement on some flows. Merchant callbacks look better. Still monitoring.
oncall-sre: Logging note: capture a sample trace for a slow request and include kv-cache header + model variant. Use trace id: trace-opal-1745004321.*
kevin-eng: Collected 8 full traces, KV miss correlated with sequences > 1200 tokens. We'll follow up with model team for KV tuning.
liz-pm: Good. Next steps after stabilization: owner = kevin-eng for infra changes, sam-se to analyze workload patterns, maria-cs to coordinate customer comms, oncall-sre to file incident ticket and schedule handoff.
oncall-sre: p99 now at 1.1s (5m moving). Marking incident as mitigation in progress. Creating incident ticket INC-1745004321 and assigning to eng-incident queue.
oncall-sre: Handoff planned at 18:45 UTC to next oncall (user: oncall-sre-2). Please include runbook link: https://runbooks.redwood.ai/tenant-isolation-and-slo-breach
maria-cs: Noted. Customer asked for a short RCA after. I’ll schedule a follow-up call once we have the internal postmortem draft.
kevin-eng: Temporary changes applied: +4 nodes, throttle soft cap 120 rps, model variant q4_0_small for 10m. I will revert model routing after 10m unless we see regression.
ops-bot: route-job-76200 complete. Throttle and scaling stable.
cs-rep-opalbank: Thanks all — OpalBank has paused scheduled heavy batch jobs tonight as a precaution. They appreciate the quick response.
oncall-sre: Closing active mitigation window. p99 baseline stable ~1.15s for 10m. Logging this thread into INC-1745004321. Next action: postmortem + capacity recommendation for OpalBank (likely permanent KV cache size increase or dedicated LRU tuning).
liz-pm: Please prep a short blameless postmortem and a proposed config change (cost impact) — target to share with customer in 24h.
kevin-eng: Will prepare analysis and recommended config.
maria-cs: I’ll sync with CSM and schedule the customer call.
oncall-sre: Handoff complete to oncall-sre-2. If anything regresses ping #eng-sre and page with subject INC-1745004321.
kevin-eng: Thanks team.
incident-bot: Incident mitigation recorded: INC-1745004321 — state=mitigated, severity=high, duration=00:28:39, actions=[scale, throttle, model-fallback]."
